pages.text: Forged armor comes in three weights, made in the usual armor shapes:$(li)$(bold)Brigandine$() (light): hardened leather and rivets on a gambeson. Dyeable. The least armor, no penalty.$(li)$(bold)Hauberk$() (medium): chain links on a leather backing.$(li)$(bold)Plate$() (heavy): plates on a leather backing. The most armor and toughness, but a little slow.
pages.title: Three Weights
